method.selection: For discussion only, rank already-seen completed cost pairs by the smaller terminal equity across 10/25bp; inspect the leading three and preserve all family statistics. This is explicitly post hoc and does not validate selection for future trading.
method.funding: Each separate model starts USD500 once; daily and monthly equity reconcile cash + receivables + liquidation-value positions. No monthly resets or new deposits. No summing independent hypothetical account profits.
method.concentration: Removing top closed-trade contributions is fixed-book attribution only; later quantities and paths are not rerun. Net P&L includes final open-position mark.
method.quarters: Q1-Q3 are complete; Oct1-Oct5 is partial Q4. Quarterly and monthly results inherit prior capital, and are not independently funded test folds.
method.extreme_check: For top three paired models, independently recompute every held/entry/exit-day close return after applying source split ratios; separately check selected signal-day flags and entry-open gaps. No outcomes removed.

limits: No absence-of-error guarantee: ticker history, current-directory survivorship, revised corporate actions, USD dividend assumptions and fillability remain unverified.
Fixed thresholds and best results use the same observed2026 window. Neither positive cost pairs nor quarter slices constitute forward or independent evidence.
No historical executable option prices; this is equity-only, not an options wealth model.
